_comment: Implementation constants of the M5/M6/M8 analysis scripts (scripts/run_subtypes.py, run_cross_lineage.py, run_m5_audits.py, run_combinatorial_lookup.py, run_limits.py, build_candidate_cards.py; src/biomark/m5.py, src/biomark/limits.py). NOT a design file: every DESIGN §F number is read from design_params.json / primary_endpoints.json (subtypes_s8, combinatorial_s11, limits_s12, dictionary_s3, ...). This file holds the operational choices DESIGN §8, §11 and §12 leave to the implementation (file layouts, column names, level names, per-line hit rule of the harmonised combinatorial table, binning of the matched background); each is explained in docs/impl_notes_pipeline.md (section 'M5 / M6 / M8 analysis scripts'). Created after freeze-bounds, before any M5-M8 output existed.

catalogue._comment: A7: MD-global is the catalogue; MD-strict is computed alongside everywhere the design says 'catalogue'.

subtypes.share_terms: EN-pred selected features of g (both stages)
subtypes.continuous_carrier_rule: dependency side of the D median: sign(beta) * (x - median_D(x)) < 0

culture.rescue_stratum: level of the flagging variable holding most subtype members; test = confounder model on those lines

hypermutation._comment: persist_beta_frac mirrors design_params.subtypes_s8.hypermutation_persist; hypermutated = MSI or TMB in the top dictionary_s3.hypermutated_top_frac of D

cross_lineage._comment: A7-iii caveat: a cross-lineage label whose powered lineages contain at most one with nominal per-lineage p < single_lineage_p_max (same sign) is flagged 'single_lineage_driven'.

esmaeili._comment: Screen-level hit = the pair is in the authors' per-study hit list (Figure1_E). Line-level hit = a Supp_table1 row (one sheet per study_line) with CohenD >= line_hit_size_min and deltaMean <= line_hit_effect_max (the authors' sign convention: synthetic-lethal pairs have positive CohenD and negative deltaMean), counted only in studies whose hit list contains the pair.

flister._comment: Only the preprint's own screens (own_lines) are counted; its columns re-calling other studies are ignored so no screen is counted twice. Analysis only: no row of this file is written anywhere.

memory._comment: row chunk of the streamed EB fit over every S1-obs U row (m5.eb_fit_streamed); the arms table is never loaded whole (coordinator: <= ~2 GB per script)
